name: BookCollection

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving a large collection of books and records

setting.relationship_dynamic: Collectors trying to relocate a large personal collection
setting.background: They are moving to a new apartment and have accumulated hundreds of books and vinyl records over many years
setting.conversation_style: Detailed logistics with disagreements about packing and downsizing

scenario_template.note: They realize that their books and records represent a surprisingly large portion of the move
They discover that large boxes filled with books are too heavy to move comfortably
They ask the Assistant how to divide and label boxes so they are easier to transport
Assistant helps them think through packing records, rare books, and other delicate items

scenario_template.topic: Shelving does not fit the new room
scenario_template.note: They discover that their existing shelves are too large for the new space
One person is willing to sell or donate duplicates while the other wants to keep everything
They establish a practical system for moving and organizing the collection in the new home

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
